description.value: The Kanata Invermere is a 100% Canadian-owned chain hotel nestled in the Columbia Valley, offering a wide range of room types from standard queens to full kitchen suites and family rooms. The on-site Rocky River Grill provides meals and beverages for guests after a day of exploring the valley. It is one of several Kanata Inns locations spread across western Canada.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the hotel is an active, Canadian-owned chain property in Invermere, BC with multiple room types and an on-site restaurant (Rocky River Grill). All contact details (phone 1-250-342-8888, address 8888 Arrow Road) are corroborated by the website's contact page. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or any cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the website; Wi-Fi is confirmed by both OSM (internet_access=wlan) and the website ('Free High Speed Internet' listed in every room type).
concerns: No mention of bike storage or any cycling-specific amenities on the website; both required criteria are unverifiable.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The hotel is a legitimate, active accommodation in the Columbia Valley, but the website contains no evidence of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, or any cycling-specific amenities required for a confident WWC inclusion. Direct outreach to confirm bike storage arrangements is needed before listing.
